people.tiEn: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco
people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy across AI infrastructure, networking, security, and collaboration. He focuses on bringing startup speed and product-led thinking to large-scale engineering organizations.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司横跨 AI 基础设施、网络、安全与协作的产品战略。他致力于把创业公司的速度与产品驱动思维带入大型工程组织。

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 负责人
people.bioEn: Tibo Sottiaux leads ChatGPT and Codex at OpenAI, overseeing major consumer product launches including Codex, ChatGPT Work, and the Dots personal agent platform.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥是 OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 的负责人，主导了 Codex、ChatGPT Work 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台等多项重要消费级产品的发布。

episodes.tEn: Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months; don't fine-tune, bet on model improvements and focus on delivery.
views.zh: 为模型三到六个月后的能力而构建，而非今天或一年后；不要做微调，押注模型自身的进步，专注交付价值。

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than willingness to learn; hire for growth potential, not resumes or logos.
views.zh: 领域专业知识不如学习意愿重要；招聘看成长潜力，而非光鲜简历或大厂背景。

views.en: Culture and hiring are critical for Scaling; invest in team during good times to cushion downturns.
views.zh: 文化与招聘对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；在顺境中投资团队，为低谷储备缓冲。

views.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
views.zh: AI 现在将是它最差的时刻；我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

views.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people; storytelling sells vision to all stakeholders.
views.zh: 领导者应通过招揽更聪明的人让自己变得可替代；叙事能力是把愿景卖给所有利益相关方的关键。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace coders who debug deep systems.
views.zh: AI 让软件开发人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力，仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

views.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence, avoiding vendor lock-in.
views.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能，避免被供应商锁定。

views.en: Specialized decision models beat general god models: more controllable, cost-efficient, safer; fusion models reach frontier quality cheaper.
views.zh: 专用决策模型胜过通用“神模型”：更可控、更省钱、更安全；融合模型能以更低成本达到前沿模型质量。

views.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up EA language by commercial entities; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
views.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分论据表明 AI 会杀死所有人。

views.en: Young people should explore, not optimize early; AI enables interest-driven learning, and agents enable self-driving organizations.
views.zh: 年轻人应探索而非过早优化；AI 支持兴趣驱动的学习，智能体将催生自驱动组织。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Early on, he argues the field optimized the wrong task: RLHF makes models mode-drop, so LLMs assist but cannot reliably automate. Data and task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong.
views.zh: 早期他主张领域优化错了任务：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）让模型模式崩塌，LLM 只能辅助、无法可靠自动化。数据与任务比算力更重要，『苦涩教训』是错的。

views.en: He deepens this into a product thesis: AI is super smart yet fails at basic economically valuable work. Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; intelligence per dollar is the key metric.
views.zh: 他把这一点深化为产品命题：AI 极其聪明，却做不好基本的有经济价值的工作。让 AI 可信的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；每美元智能才是关键指标。

views.en: He reframes the fix as a new primitive: natural language plus state machine, a decision model. Jev is an early decision model, like early ChatGPT, and will improve with Scaling（规模扩张）.
views.zh: 他把解法重构为新原语：自然语言加状态机，即决策模型。Jev 是早期决策模型，如同早期的 ChatGPT，会随 Scaling（规模扩张）而改进。

views.en: He sharpens the diagnosis: RLHF destroyed model calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated for decisions. RLCD optimizes for calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs for engineers.
views.zh: 他进一步锐化诊断：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）摧毁了模型校准；预训练模型在决策上校准更好。RLCD 优化校准决策，把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮。

views.en: Most recently he shifts emphasis to post-training: pre-training is inefficient, and 10x jumps will come from post-training breakthroughs. Harnesses are overrated; model intelligence and data distribution drive agent success.
views.zh: 最近他把重心转向后训练：预训练低效，10 倍跃升将来自后训练突破。外壳被高估；模型智能与数据分布才决定智能体的成败。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and will be built by lots of software.
views.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

views.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
views.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只负责审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models, though adoption is lower than enterprises want.
views.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将指数级增长，尽管采用率低于企业期望。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
views.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

views.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: Great strategies take years; identify the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
views.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年才能见效；要找出主要瓶颈，并让整个公司聚焦于此。

views.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; enterprise context and process re-engineering are key.
views.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造才是关键。

views.en: Current existential risk from AI is close to zero; cyber risk is the real and urgent danger.
views.zh: 当前 AI 的生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是真实而紧迫的危险。

views.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement would require four conditions that are not happening.
views.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生。

views.en: Most enterprises are far behind in AI adoption; they need context and ontology, not smarter models.
views.zh: 大多数企业在 AI 采用上远远落后；它们需要的是上下文与本体，而不是更聪明的模型。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice matter as AI commoditizes quality.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得商品化，人类的品味与个人声音反而更有价值。

views.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship erodes.
views.zh: 年轻人并非天生会用 AI；缺乏领域专长导致他们误用 AI，随着学徒制瓦解，人才梯队正在断裂。

views.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth chatbot co-intelligence prompting.
views.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，终结了来回提示的共智能聊天模式。

views.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; the jagged frontier persists, and AI's opacity is likely permanent.
views.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面；能力锯齿状前沿依然存在，而 AI 的不透明性很可能是永久的。

views.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it, so experts and small-m management matter more.
views.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专长，因此专家与小写 m 的管理能力更加重要。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks across function spaces, beating physics-based weather models while being far faster; domain structure like spherical geometry is key.
views.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间之间的映射，能在任意分辨率上预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型，却快上数万倍，而球面几何等领域结构对长期气候建模的稳定性至关重要。

views.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
views.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 在高分辨率物理模拟中并不实用；物理世界的结构要求替代性架构，这与语言模型的世界截然不同。

views.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can surpass training data quality, unlike sparse human feedback in RLHF.
views.zh: 以偏微分方程作为训练信号的物理式自我改进，能超越训练数据本身的质量；这与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）中稀疏的人类反馈形成对比。

views.en: Accelerated Understanding aims at a universal physics model, combining domains like language models unified NLP, with collaborative learning across physics branches.
views.zh: 「加速理解」旨在打造通用物理模型，像语言模型统一 NLP 那样整合多个领域；多物理分支的协同学习让单一模型胜过各自独立的专用模型。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each; trillion-token contexts require reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure.
views.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每个分支的表现，而不只是靠增大模型规模；万亿级 token 的上下文窗口需要重新发明分片与切分基础设施，融合高性能计算与现代机器学习。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；在智能体式时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势。

views.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability make it the perfect OS for AI agents.
views.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化特性，使其成为 AI 智能体的理想操作系统。

views.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
views.zh: 手写代码已不再具备经济生产力；如今用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更好。

views.en: The agent era began November 24 with Opus 45, a true inflection point.
views.zh: 智能体时代始于 11 月 24 日的 Opus 45，这是一个真正的拐点。

views.en: AI doom predictions are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play.
views.zh: AI 末日论被夸大；乐观是唯一理性的博弈论选择。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency, not human clicks.
views.zh: 智能体对网页的使用量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

views.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive indexing and ranking, compressing information into tiny models.
views.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动索引与排序，把信息压缩进小模型。

views.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need web search for fresh, specific facts.
views.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要网页搜索来获取新鲜、具体的事实。

views.en: The ads model dies with agents; content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation, and inference-time data transactions will be hugely valuable.
views.zh: 广告模式会随智能体而消亡；内容方须通过 Shapley 值估算获得报酬，而推理时的数据交易将极具价值。

views.en: Frontier models keep getting bigger while smaller models plateau; alignment is not adversary-proof, so deliberate misuse must be contained.
views.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，小模型则趋于平台期；对齐无法抵御对抗，必须遏制蓄意滥用。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem design: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
views.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态设计：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，以联邦优先权取代各州拼凑式监管来保护初创企业。

views.en: He argues the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated—evidence that early firm regulation fails as technology outpaces rules.
views.zh: 他认为在 ChatGPT 之前写就的欧盟《人工智能法案》已经过时，证明过早的硬性监管会因技术跑赢规则而失效。

views.en: On risk, he downplays biological threats as overblown and urges regulating model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
views.zh: 在风险议题上，他淡化生物风险、称其被夸大，并主张监管模型输出而非过度监管训练过程。

views.en: He extends the same logic to science: fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not centralized institutions, to restore US breakthroughs.
views.zh: 他把同一逻辑延伸到科学：资助基础性、竞争前研发与科学家个人而非集中化机构，以恢复美国的突破能力。

views.en: He rejects climate emergency framing and DEI grants as dogma, insisting the administration is pro-science but anti-dogma, with AI applied to science via the Genesis mission.
views.zh: 他拒绝气候紧急状态叙事与 DEI 拨款，称其为教条，坚称政府亲科学但反教条，并通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 应用于科学。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
views.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在于规模扩张与可靠的人类级表现，而非制造本身。

views.en: The real constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; human data is the pre-training prior for robotics.
views.zh: 真正的约束是数据，而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

views.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing scaling laws.
views.zh: 机器人已进入缩放曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，呼应缩放定律。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning all the way down.
views.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；需要端到端的深度学习实现全身自主。

views.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world.
views.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练配合强化学习让智能体在真实世界奏效。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.tiZh: 联合创始人，Chai Discovery
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.
people.bioZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人（Chai-1／Chai-2 蛋白质模型）。芝加哥大学计算机科学博士，曾在 Meta 任研究科学家实习生。

episodes.tEn: Chai Discovery: The AI-Native Software Factory for Drug Discovery

people.tiZh: 物理学家，斯坦福讲师
people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由一小群人通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式 AI 应被看作乐器而非造假，产品界面必须具备容错性，以匹配算法当前的能力。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, but near-term impact on big firms is overhyped.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变：生成式 AI 让产品走向对话式、双向对称；但他也强调，AI 对大公司的近期影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施。

views.en: Inference's marginal cost forces new business models; expose data via APIs and MCP so non-developers can build with AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化判断：推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，不同于传统软件；公司应通过 API 和 MCP 开放数据，让非开发者也能用 AI 工具构建。

views.en: Use AI to give users control over algorithms, not to maximize engagement; 'time well spent' and long-tenure synchronized leadership win.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场更明确：AI 应让用户掌控算法，而非让人更上瘾；Spotify 追求“时间花得值”而非参与度指标，并以长期任期的同步式领导应对技术变革。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak
Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施与行动——而非空想——才是深科技破局的关键。

views.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulation, and data management.
views.zh: 同年他提出：AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代者，尤其在编程、合规与数据管理上。

views.en: Failure in deep tech is organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
views.zh: 他反共识地指出：深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术，CEO 的判断无法外包。

views.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 在 No Priors 上他主张：大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的核心。

views.en: Retinal implants prove BCIs; substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility.
views.zh: 他进一步深化：视网膜植入是 BCI 的验证，借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

views.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know if a browser idea works once it's built and used daily.
views.zh: 原型制作至关重要，因为网络本身是混乱的；浏览器想法只有被真正做出来并每天使用，才知道是否可行。

views.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
views.zh: 设计团队不应总是作为一个整体行动；让个体留下印记、容纳多元声音，才能做出更好的作品。

views.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers is crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
views.zh: 为浏览器这类实用产品注入情感与个性，是创造令人难忘、愉悦体验的关键。

views.en: Designers should follow curiosity and tinker with new technology, balancing intuition with data rather than over-intellectualizing.
views.zh: 设计师应追随好奇心、摆弄新技术，在直觉与数据之间平衡，而不是过度理性化。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
views.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以出现。

views.en: Claude Design stays a throwaway ideation tool, not a production builder; models lack taste, so ask for volume.
views.zh: Claude Design 保持为一次性的构思工具，而非生产级构建器；模型仍缺乏品味，所以应要求大量选项。

views.en: In the AI era, being uncomfortably early beats polishing; humans still monopolize good design ideas while models do busy work.
views.zh: 在 AI 时代，早得令人不适胜过精雕细琢；好设计想法仍由人类垄断，模型只擅长杂活。

He joined Facebook in 2006, built News Feed, and later ran ads and consumer hardware before becoming CTO in 2022.

Giving Humans Superpowers with AI and AR

views.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；并认为大想法来自领导者自上而下，而非自下而上的文化神话。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为“词语计算器”而非类人智能，认为除缩放定律外还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型，并看好开源与具身 AI、可穿戴设备带来超能力。

views.en: AI inverts the app model: users express intent, AI orchestrates services; smart glasses evolve into AI glasses toward a post-phone future.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 会颠覆应用模式：用户表达意图、AI 编排服务；智能眼镜将演化为 AI 眼镜，通向“后手机”未来，开源则是商品化互补层的战略。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence; reinforcement learning now matters far more than predicted, but the monolithic model era ended.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，强化学习的作用远超预期，但单体模型时代已结束；前沿与开源差距未必缩小，数据是价值之源。

views.en: Most jobs don't need frontier intelligence; AI should maximize individuals, and the hype cycle will bring a valley of discontent before long-term benefit.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断多数工作不需要前沿智能，AI 应放大个体、自动化琐事；并警告 AI 炒作周期会先带来失望低谷，能源与核能是最上游变量。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the guiding framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是指导框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

views.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage: focus on internal correctness over external validation, and it becomes self-fulfilling.
views.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势：专注内部正确性而非外部认可，久而久之会自我实现。

views.en: The next industrial revolution is Industrial AI across food, mining, transport; the final boss is resistance to change, not competitors.
views.zh: 下一场工业革命是横跨食品、采矿、运输的工业 AI；最终的 Boss 是抗拒变化，而非竞争对手。

views.en: Uber succeeded despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty—love the new mission instead.
views.zh: Uber 的成功是尽管有激进文化，而非因为激进文化；以复仇为燃料是肮脏的——不如爱上新使命。

views.en: For industrial-scale tasks specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge drives network effects, and real estate is an underappreciated part of the physical AI stack.
views.zh: 工业级任务中专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，而房地产是物理 AI 技术栈中被低估的一环。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste, craft, and judgment remain essential.
views.zh: AI 的输出只是起点而非最终结果；人类的品味、手艺与判断力始终不可或缺。

views.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design; interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
views.zh: 在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；与模型的交互将超越提示词。

views.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
views.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产环境。

views.en: Design is not dead; it matters more than ever for scalable, real systems, with a point of view.
views.zh: 设计并未消亡；对于可扩展的真实系统，它比以往更重要，且需要独特观点。

episodes.tEn: Seize the AI Opportunity: Action Over Certainty
AI Slop and the Evolution of Design Tools

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not chase trends; use screenshots and a design.md style guide, and iterate as editors from references.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师要用 AI 自建工具而非追逐潮流：以截图和 design.md 风格指南为起点，像编辑一样从参考中迭代，否则很快沦为 AI slop。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter; to use super-intelligent models you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system.
views.zh: 同月他反共识地指出：AI 并没有变得更聪明，要发挥超级智能模型的能力，必须提供带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

views.en: He writes 0% of the code now; AI writes everything, but precise communication—even via video—is essential.
views.zh: 他坦言现在自己写 0% 的代码，全部由 AI 完成，但精确沟通（甚至用视频教 AI 做动画）才是关键。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship at 80%, and solve one painful expensive problem.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他把视角转向行动：AI 是一生最大的技术机会，要在准备好之前就开始、做到 80% 就发布，专注解决一个高付费客户的痛点。

views.en: High intelligence can hold people back via overthinking and perfectionism; the safe corporate job is gone, so going on offense is the real low-risk move.
views.zh: 他进一步反共识：高智力常因过度思考与完美主义拖累人；安全的公司职位已不存在，主动出击创业才是真正的低风险选择。

episodes.tEn: Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）作为单一模型统治一切是错的；数百万个专用模型、每个用例一个,将成为主流。

views.en: Token costs drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage; inference is not a commodity.
views.zh: Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍,带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品,专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, the real moat beyond product-market fit.
views.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型,这才是超越产品市场契合的真正护城河。

views.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning: facts, taste, expertise.
views.zh: 从提示到 RAG、到微调、再到强化学习的演进,映射人类学习:事实、品味、专长。

views.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
views.zh: 在产品市场契合后再启动后训练；先优化增长、再优化利润,避免 Scaling（规模扩张）到破产。

The Art of Product Building in the Age of AI
From Instagram to AI: Mike Krieger on Solo Entrepreneurship
From Instagram to Anthropic: Mike Krieger on AI's Future

views.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and treat AI as a thought partner that preserves user agency.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在模型能力边缘构建、拥抱破坏式迭代，并把 AI 当作保留用户自主权的思考伙伴，而非拐杖。

views.en: AI lets small teams scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, as AI moves from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker.
views.zh: 同年他进一步提出，AI 让小团队也能规模化并保持概念完整性；应为未来模型能力而非当下局限而构建，AI 将从助手走向协作者再到自主同事。

views.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, and rewriting software in days is now viable.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向智能体式设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切，难点从加功能变成砍功能，借助 AI 几天内重写软件已可行。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back on feedback, and multiplayer human-model collaboration remains underexplored.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他强调长周期任务委托与验证闭环重塑生产力，模型应敢于反驳反馈，多人与多模型协作仍待探索。

views.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and product usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing matter more than token usage.
views.zh: 最近他聚焦 Anthropic Labs：弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 自主性与自我认知；相比可被博弈的 token 用量，token 效率与按结果定价更关键。

The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; VM sandbox provides safety.
views.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问与用户相同的工具，最好是在本地计算机上；VM 沙箱提供安全保障。

views.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding may become less important as models improve.
views.zh: 技能作为 markdown 文件可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要。

views.en: AI best handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; biggest gap is people understanding AI can tackle almost any problem.
views.zh: AI 最适合处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距是人们理解 AI 可以解决几乎任何问题。

views.en: Live artifacts in Claude allow auto-refreshing dashboards; use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus for unclear asks.
views.zh: Claude 中的实时工件允许自动刷新仪表板；对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于不明确的请求使用 Opus。

views.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask for; building custom hardware with Claude Code is accessible and cheap.
views.zh: 孩子们擅长使用 AI，因为他们还没有学会不该问什么；使用 Claude Code 构建定制硬件既方便又便宜。

views.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's core as ephemeral visual communication with close friends, not a broadcast social network; copying by competitors validates innovation.
views.zh: 早期阶段，斯皮格尔将 Snapchat 的核心定义为与亲密好友的短暂视觉沟通，而非广播式社交网络；被竞争对手抄袭反而验证了创新的价值。

views.en: He deepens the moat thesis: software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy, so Snap builds AR glasses and a platform.
views.zh: 他深化了护城河论点：软件不是护城河，生态系统、平台和硬件更难被复制，因此 Snap 转向构建 AR 眼镜与平台。

views.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity; over two-thirds of new code is AI-written, making distribution and creativity the scarce resources.
views.zh: AI 将价值从执行转向创造力；超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写，使分发和创造力成为稀缺资源。

views.en: He consistently argues computing should become more human: AR glasses anchor content in the world, ephemerality mirrors real conversation, and phones will coexist rather than be replaced.
views.zh: 他始终主张计算应变得更人性化：AR 眼镜将内容锚定在现实世界中，短暂性呼应真实对话，手机将共存而非被取代。

views.en: His stance on AI and regulation matures: AI optimism becomes contrarian amid doomerism, parental controls beat bans, and EQ matters more than IQ in the AI age.
views.zh: 他对 AI 与监管的立场逐渐成熟：在末日论盛行时，AI 乐观主义反而成为反共识；家长控制优于政府禁令；在 AI 时代，情商比智商更重要。
