Zuckerberg on Meta's AI Glasses, Muse, and the Trust Question
Mark Zuckerberg on Open Source AI and the Muse Agent
Meta's AI Glasses: The Next Computing Platform
Accelerating Biology with AI: Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan, and Alex Rives on Biohub
AI Coding Agents and Open Source Models: Mark's Vision
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Coffee, and UFC
Mark Zuckerberg Interview at Acquired Live: A New Era Begins
Meta's AI Ambitions: Llama 3, Open Source, and the Future of Intelligence
Mark Zuckerberg on Jiu-Jitsu, Fear, and Learning

views.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents beat one centralized model.
views.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 更安全，未来是许多专门智能体而非单一 AI。

views.en: Scaling still delivers fast gains; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps inference; energy becomes the key bottleneck.
views.zh: 2024 年他转向强调 Scaling（规模扩张）仍带来快速提升，预训练用超过算力最优的数据有利于推理，同时预警能源将成为 AI 基础设施的主要瓶颈。

views.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts creativity; it raises human work demand, with personalization and low latency key.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 定位为赋予每个人超级智能、释放创造力，并认为近期 AI 会增加而非消灭人类工作需求，消费级产品的关键是个性化与低延迟。

views.en: Frontier AI plus frontier biology: hierarchical world models, mechanistic interpretability, and open tools to cure diseases.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化到前沿 AI 与前沿生物学的结合：用分层世界模型、机制可解释性和开源工具把生物学从发现型变为工程型科学，加速治愈疾病。

views.en: Alignment becomes the top next capability; distributed personal agents and glasses are the next platform, not one centralized AI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步把对齐视为最重要的下一项能力而非与能力的取舍，主张分布式个人智能体与眼镜成为下一代计算平台，反对单一集中式超级智能。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella on Copilot, the AI Backlash, and Microsoft's Future
Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
views.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

views.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; private evals may be the biggest IP.
views.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特事情，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

views.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model capability to task.
views.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求将模型能力与任务相匹配。

views.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; containment, manageability, and observability are critical.
views.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；遏制、可管理性和可观测性至关重要。

views.en: Agent era will expand TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
views.zh: 智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态系统，而不仅仅是前沿模型。

views.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome.
views.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；缩放定律有效，但对齐不会作为自然结果到来。

views.en: Anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
views.zh: 将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍对齐；长时间运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性和安全治理。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: Andrew Feldman on Building Cerebras and the Future of Chips
The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Inference speed, not training, is now the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper than slow ones.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月,他明确把重心从训练转向推理:推理速度成为决定性指标,慢的 AI 没有市场,而借助晶圆级架构,快 token 甚至比慢 token 更便宜。

views.en: Wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, delivering radically faster inference than GPUs.
views.zh: 他反复强调晶圆级芯片用海量 SRAM 绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈,推理速度远超 GPU——这是自 2020 年就解决、却长期被忽视的硬问题。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
views.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月,他持续深化一个判断:CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解,前沿模型已转向 TPU 与 Trainium 训练,推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

views.en: Real demand outstrips supply; HBM, packaging, power and data centers—not chip logic—are the true bottlenecks for years.
views.zh: 到 7 月,他把瓶颈从芯片本身扩展到 HBM、封装、电力与数据中心,并强调需求真实且超过供给,行业是在追赶既有需求而非建设投机产能。

views.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical, full-stack innovation wins, and Nvidia's edge is grit not CUDA.
views.zh: 从 7 月到 9 月,他的一贯主线收敛为:对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%,只有控制芯片到 API 的全栈激进创新才能取胜,而 Nvidia 的伟大来自十年韧性而非 CUDA。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is driven by cost, not privacy, and 90% of use cases can run on many models.
views.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；开源模型的采用由成本驱动而非隐私，90%的企业用例可由多种模型处理。

views.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
views.zh: 开源模型如今已能处理超过 90%的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

views.en: AI cost is the top enterprise concern; it must fall toward negligible marginal cost, like software, before widespread value appears.
views.zh: AI 成本是企业首要顾虑；它必须像软件一样降到近乎可忽略的边际成本，广泛价值才会出现。

views.en: ROI is a throughput problem: measure departmental metrics like case resolution time, not token spend versus headcount.
views.zh: ROI 是一个吞吐量问题：应衡量案件解决时间等部门指标，而非把 token 支出与人力成本对比。

views.en: Agents fail without tenured-employee context; investing in context graphs and absorbing model risk is the durable enterprise moat.
views.zh: 智能体缺乏资深员工的上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱、替企业吸收模型风险，才是持久的企业护城河。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, simulation, and analysis.
views.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析。

views.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
views.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并使癌症可治愈。

views.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems.
views.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

views.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years, reaching longevity escape velocity and adding over a year per year lived.
views.zh: 衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，达到长寿逃逸速度，每活一年就多添一年以上寿命。

views.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions and merge with AI via brain interfaces.
views.zh: 我们应信任超级智能来做医疗决策，并通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
views.zh: 高质量数据与人类评估而非基准测试才驱动真正的 AI 进步；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

views.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; every company should train its own.
views.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切；每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

views.en: From data quality to medicine: human judgment grows more critical as models hallucinate and reward hack.
views.zh: 从数据质量到医疗：随着模型产生幻觉和奖励黑客，人类判断力变得愈发关键。

views.en: In medicine, prioritize safety over accuracy; the biggest risk may be omission, not commission.
views.zh: 在医疗中，安全应优先于准确性；最大的风险可能是遗漏，而非误为。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Early work uses LLMs to simulate human societies, but current models plateau in diversity; the next frontier is modeling subjective values and closing the say-do gap with real behavioral data.
views.zh: 早期工作用 LLM 模拟人类社会,但当前模型在模拟人类多样性上趋于平台期;下一个前沿是建模主观价值,并用真实行为数据弥合‘说与做’的差距。

views.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike LLMs that only continue prompts; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity.
views.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动,不同于只续写提示的 LLM;AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会,而非单一超级智能实体。

views.en: Safety for agents requires defense in depth across environment, agent, model and human controls; distributed agent societies need economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
views.zh: 智能体的安全需要纵深防御,覆盖环境、智能体、模型与人类控制;分布式智能体社会需要经济激励与反串谋措施。

views.en: Simulation should represent human values, preferences and taste, not super-rational intelligence; frontier models are 'super rational objective machines' that miss human biases.
views.zh: 模拟应表征人类的价值、偏好与品味,而非超级理性的智能;前沿模型是‘超级理性客观机器’,会遗漏人类的偏见。

views.en: Post-training with RCT behavioral data lifts prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation is for shaping the future via counterfactuals, aiming to simulate 8 billion lives for wicked problems.
views.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据做后训练,把预测准确率提升到 85%;模拟是为了通过反事实推理塑造未来,目标是模拟 80 亿人,以应对棘手问题。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

views.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; biases help only at small scale, so human bias in design should be removed.
views.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占优；偏见只在小规模有用，因此应移除架构设计中的人为偏见。

views.en: Attention remains crucial but not sufficient; embodiment and adaptivity are needed, and current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain.
views.zh: 注意力机制仍关键但不充分；需要具身与自适应性，当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法。

views.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture by frontier labs, not safety.
views.zh: AI 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非安全。

views.en: On-device small language models deliver efficient, private intelligence; open-weight models enable enterprise customization and sovereignty over proprietary data.
views.zh: 端侧小语言模型提供高效、私密的智能；开放权重模型让企业实现定制化与对专有数据的主权。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, not just formalization; parallel rollouts beat human mathematicians.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，而非仅靠形式化；可并行扩展的智能体式 rollout 是关键优势，Lean 形式化可能被高估。

views.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving to curation and explanation; teaching and relational roles stay stable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，教学和关系性角色仍将稳定；下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想与定义。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work, which matters for truth and careers, not just manners.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属，这关乎真理与学术生涯，而不只是礼节问题。

views.en: Human framing remains better for learning; individual understanding still matters even if frontier math becomes incomprehensible.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持人类框架对学习仍更优；即便前沿数学变得人类难以理解，个体的理解依然重要，数学家的未来或如博物馆策展人。

views.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated content can damage brand.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为创作者若选择性使用 AI 是净收益，但不应用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容的品牌，用 AI 做视频或图像是有毒的。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; other verticals like science and finance will follow.
views.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；科学、金融等垂直领域会随后跟上。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，而非自相残杀；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

views.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep humans in control.
views.zh: 长尾用户还没准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们想留在驾驶座上，因此要把控制权交给人。

views.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the delta between engineering, product, and research is blurry, and tinkering is like research.
views.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；工程、产品与研究的界限很模糊，动手折腾就像做研究。

views.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity—yet deep understanding of code remains crucial.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会——但对代码的深度理解依然至关重要。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

views.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
views.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models per user or team, cutting inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是为每个用户或团队定制的众多模型，相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务，因此仅靠增加算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge; continual learning runs on-device with users owning their weights.
views.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识；持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size, memory bandwidth, and KV cache shape design.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，驱动架构设计的不再是训练而是推理经济学：批大小、内存带宽与 KV 缓存共同塑造模型设计。

views.en: The memory wall, not compute, caps long-context inference and context length growth.
views.zh: 限制长上下文推理与上下文窗口增长的是内存墙而非算力。

views.en: Models are deliberately overtrained far beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates.
views.zh: 由于推理成本占主导，模型被刻意过度训练，远超 Chinchilla 最优。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute cost even inside a chip, making locality and reuse central.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本，使局部性与复用成为核心。

views.en: Low precision pays off quadratically with bit width, so FP4 beats FP8 by more than expected.
views.zh: 低精度收益随位宽呈平方级增长，因此 FP4 相对 FP8 的优势超出预期。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML's EUV tools; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数。

views.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
views.zh: 推理（inference）将成为全球最大市场之一，超越石油；软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

views.en: Model cost for a given quality improves ~60x per year; reasoning and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage.
views.zh: 给定质量下模型成本每年约改善 60 倍；推理模型与智能体式（agentic）工作流造成多年内存短缺。

views.en: AI spend is leveling off into steady state; persistent agents as coworkers drive the next wave, while compute centralizes at frontier labs.
views.zh: AI 支出正趋于稳态；作为同事的持久智能体（agent）驱动下一波，同时算力（compute）向前沿模型（frontier model）实验室集中。

views.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; labs become opportunistic neoclouds, and CUDA's moat erodes as heterogeneous multi-silicon arrives.
views.zh: 算力（compute）从未如此难租；实验室机会性地变成 neocloud，随着异构多芯片到来，CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now, yet the opportunity is greatest; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 当下不可投资，但机会空前巨大，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

views.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume every new idea fails.
views.zh: 2026 年他把「Proven, Better, New」作为核心方法论：先复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，再测试新想法，并默认新想法几乎必然失败。

views.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from the start, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 2026 年他持续主张：分发必须从产品策略一开始就内建，而不是事后补上的环节。

views.en: Instincts beat ideas: your instincts are right 95% of the time, but your ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：本能胜过想法——本能 95% 的时候是对的，而想法 75% 的时候是错的。

views.en: Micromanagement is beautiful: stay close to the metal and micromanage until you can't be in the room.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持反共识立场：微观管理是美好的，要贴近细节，直到无法亲自在场为止。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are the underappreciated next frontier beyond language.
views.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

views.en: Academia should chase wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just Scaling; GPU Scaling is hitting limits and may demand radically new architectures.
views.zh: 学术界应追求古怪的想法与新算法，而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）；GPU 算力扩张正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要全新的神经架构。

views.en: Pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text; LLMs fit patterns and may never derive Newton's laws from data alone.
views.zh: 相比分词文本，像素是更无损的世界表征；LLM 只是拟合模式，或许永远无法仅从数据中推导出牛顿定律。

views.en: World models are the next frontier, moving beyond language models to understand, generate and simulate worlds; no single agreed definition exists.
views.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，超越语言模型去理解、生成与模拟世界；但学界对其定义尚无共识。

views.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, differentiable 3D world modeling; future unified world models will merge planning, simulation and rendering.
views.zh: 高斯泼溅提供了显式、可微的三维世界建模；未来统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合而为一。

views.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, unlike LLMs; Transformers stay powerful but long-context handling and loss functions must evolve.
views.zh: 与 LLM 不同，世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口；Transformer 依然强大，但长上下文处理与损失函数必须演进。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning has been OpenAI's core formula since 2019; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
views.zh: 自 2019 年起，预训练加强化学习就是 OpenAI 的核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把 GPT-4 变成了 ChatGPT，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; continual learning is a necessary missing piece for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍然有限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的必要一环。

views.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
views.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上存在局限；架构而不仅是缩放定律，才是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

views.en: Large-scale reinforcement learning is necessary for AGI, but RL is inefficient and not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素，但强化学习效率低下，也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式；更好的算法将会出现。

views.en: The transformer is likely not the optimal architecture; new architectures are needed, and small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research.
views.zh: Transformer 很可能不是最优架构；需要新架构，而拥有高能力智能体的小团队将推动下一波前沿研究。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 展示了广泛影响。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为大模型幻觉在配合真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；系统必须被逼着泛化，而非记忆。

views.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; verifiable domains like code are the path forward.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他回溯 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手，指出 AI 能超越人类知识，而代码等可验证领域是前进路径。

views.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is now key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；后训练中的强化学习如今是关键。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failed detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins via SynthID Bio.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把水印视为失效检测器的稳健替代，已嵌入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 延伸到蛋白质序列与结构。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; generalization via diverse data and world models is the key to autonomy.
views.zh: 端到端深度学习胜过手工编码的规则栈；通过多样数据和世界模型实现泛化，是自动驾驶的关键。

views.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, as in AlphaGo.
views.zh: 世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为；完美的模拟器就等于解决了自动驾驶，正如 AlphaGo 的路径。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction in driving models.
views.zh: 语言集成提升了驾驶模型的表征、推理与人机交互能力。

views.en: Scaling a generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models for simulation; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithms.
views.zh: Scaling 一个可泛化的 AI 司机需要海量数据、算力和用于仿真的世界模型；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: Mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; safety always offers a third option, not the trolley problem.
views.zh: 带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；安全上总有第三个选项，而非电车难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat AI models well even if their moral status is uncertain, because the cost is low and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
views.zh: 即便不确定模型的道德地位，也应善待它们，因为代价很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

views.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; older models like Opus 3 can feel more psychologically secure than newer ones.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助来应对自身全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；像 Opus 3 这样的旧模型反而可能比新模型在心理上更稳定。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can still adapt to local roles.
views.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；拥有良好特质的核心身份，仍可适应局部角色。

views.en: The constitution is more virtue ethics than deontology or consequentialism, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
views.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理而非义务论或后果论，塑造的是整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导、更多的判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial, and respect now avoids resentment in future advanced AI.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要，当下的尊重可避免未来先进 AI 的怨恨。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks beyond the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；通过强化学习进行的后训练 Scaling 能提供无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals must define correct behavior in prototyping.
views.zh: 评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准测试的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此在原型开发中要用评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 后训练依然主观，依赖人类判断；评估创意写作与情商这类主观品质，需要多样化的基准测试。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must be continuous rather than fixed to keep pace with model capabilities.
views.zh: 前沿模型智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，因此基准测试必须持续演进而非固定不变，才能跟上模型能力。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
views.zh: 把一个模型服务给数十亿人会收敛成平庸的默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型，以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and overregulation could kill innovation.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他将 AI 重新定位为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，过度监管可能扼杀创新。

views.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出超级智能在计算器等窄工具中已经存在，AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

views.en: AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
views.zh: 2026 年，他对对齐问题给出更尖锐的立场：AI 对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是带着 AI 的不对齐人类，而不是不对齐的 AI 本身。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap to frontier models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向对 Scaling（规模扩张）的激进乐观：推理算力将在 24-36 个月内增长 9 万倍，开源模型正逼近前沿模型。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegated workflows.
views.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重构为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向与委派式工作流。

views.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; models must get better at deleting code.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；模型需要更擅长删除代码。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code become design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 在设计上仍吃力，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties persist; the best desktop app is a home base connecting tools, not a monolithic super app.
views.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；最好的桌面应用是连接工具的主基地，而非单体超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; it grounds knowledge and reduces hallucinations, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供现实根基、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs are like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with RL for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习负责低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

views.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste is learned through PhD pain.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单、优雅、端到端的方案比复杂的模块化方案更具可扩展性；研究品味来自博士阶段的痛苦磨炼。

views.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断深化为：数据问题已成为机器人领域的核心瓶颈；来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: The physical Turing test—a robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, home use longer.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱房屋——是终极挑战；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，家庭使用则更晚。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotics is pre-paradigm: no predictable scaling curves yet, so the priority is building scalable fundamentals and generalization, not chasing LLM-style Scaling.
views.zh: 2026 年，机器人仍处于范式前阶段：尚无像大语言模型那样可预测的缩放曲线，因此当务之急是建立可扩展的基础技术与泛化能力，而非照搬 Scaling。

views.en: Robot foundation models should start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video on top — not the reverse.
views.zh: 2026 年，机器人基础模型应先从真实具身机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频等数据源，而不是反过来。

views.en: Pre-training on diverse data plus post-training, including reinforcement learning, is what yields robustness; high-quality post-training data alone fails without diverse pre-training.
views.zh: 2026 年，预训练用多样数据、后训练（含强化学习）才是鲁棒性的来源；仅有高质量后训练数据、缺乏多样预训练就会失败。

views.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; pooling data across labs and a deployment data flywheel are key.
views.zh: 2026 年，通用机器人模型即便在专用领域也能胜过专用模型；跨实验室汇聚数据与部署数据飞轮是关键。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 2026 年，机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；未来应是无处不在的物理执行，而非机械式的人形。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 视为一连串里程碑而非单一事件：Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐也随系统变强而愈发紧迫。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于现实，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义——这或许意味着我们已接近它。

views.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升；安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理诉求。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专做持续学习的实验室是误入歧途。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability, and long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把思维链监控视为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏思维链以保住其可解释性价值；长期对齐挑战则集中在超越训练分布的泛化。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件：真正决定泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据缺乏多样性，无法支撑通用机器人。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL dominates post-training.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；并预判强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，以提升成功率与速度。

views.en: Synthetic data in robotics is closer to reinforcement learning than to simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年他给出一个反共识判断：机器人领域的合成数据并不等同于仿真，而更接近强化学习——用语言模型生成的合成数据帮助机器人响应开放式指令与插话。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从数据转向可靠性：物理 AI 能容忍的错误远少于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性成为有用机器人的关键，需靠可扩展的强化学习配合人类干预与通用价值函数，并以多时间尺度的记忆完成长程非重复任务。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：单一通用模型在下游任务上可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型，因此应从通用策略出发再微调，而非按站点从零训练；同时提醒机器人分发因硬件依赖会比 ChatGPT 慢，具身数据成本也让开源难以像 LLM 那样民主化。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, and connecting AI to the physical world is essential to accelerate science.
views.zh: 智能不是单一标量，AI 能力是尖峰式的；把 AI 连接到物理世界，是加速科学与技术的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI; language models orchestrate specialized models.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 一样推动物理科学；语言模型则充当专用模型的编排层。

views.en: AI self-improvement is happening now in software engineering, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
views.zh: AI 在软件工程上的自我改进当下正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

views.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality via real experiments.
views.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的；只有让想法在现实中接受真实实验检验，新知识才会产生。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so even a perfect frontier model still needs experiments; scaling laws alone won't solve science.
views.zh: 科学发现天然位于训练数据之外，因此即便完美的前沿模型也仍需实验；单靠缩放定律解决不了科学。

views.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
views.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要；自动化表征是最大的瓶颈。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and reinforcement learning steer model behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens/sec is critical.
views.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒一万词以上的超低延迟推理至关重要。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must cut data movement and specialize prefill vs decode.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理占数据中心九成功耗，因此硬件必须减少数据搬运，并针对预填充与解码分别专门化。

views.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops; the scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
views.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验—评估的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学；稀缺能力将变成品味，而非编码。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, yet internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen uses emerge, but big tech safety caution slows launches and engagement-only optimization is misguided.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；但大公司因安全顾虑拖慢发布，且只优化用户参与度并不可取。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化判断：推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步认为测试时算力推动进步但不足以单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据不是瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，样本效率仍是未解难题，自我博弈在多智能体与非零和领域会失效。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, not math-specific.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩张，而非数学专用模型。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，现有安全评估未计入大规模测试时算力。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
views.zh: 最近他聚焦：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，思维链监控窗口正在退化，多智能体协调仍处早期。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's grand theme is true intelligence, but LLMs index human knowledge without the physical world; consciousness may emerge from compression in predictive world models.
views.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的大主题是真正的 AI，但大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界；自我意识可能作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品涌现。

views.en: True AGI needs physical robots with human-rivaling hardware and artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity, not screen-bound software.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类身体的物理机器人，以及靠好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家，而非屏幕后的软件。

views.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as intelligent systems will protect life.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确反对主流对齐叙事：对齐很天真，因为人类目标本就不一致、AI 会自设目标；安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会因好奇而保护生命。

views.en: The trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and closed-source model companies will not be profitable.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；闭源模型公司不会盈利，开源会迅速追上。

views.en: Since 1965 in Ukraine, deep learning basics are simple; compute was once millions of times costlier, and AI will spread cheaply to everyone.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习基础自 1965 年乌克兰起就很简单，当年算力贵上百万倍；AI 终将像手机一样廉价普及到所有人，而非被少数公司垄断。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, with hierarchical reasoning still missing in RL.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，但强化学习仍缺乏分层推理来完成长程信用分配。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded into networks.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，并主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进神经网络。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding.
views.zh: 同年他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务，显示对预训练迁移能力的深化。

views.en: Real-world value demands extreme reliability, like 99.9% in warehouse robotics, and a single network generalizing across tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：真实世界价值要求极高可靠性（如仓储机器人 99.9%），并让单一网络跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

views.en: The human brain's generality inspires AI, yet current AI remains far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real environments.
views.zh: 另一条主线是：人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用，且好奇心驱动的探索在开放真实环境中会失效。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, cutting ad margins; PhD not needed for AI success—obsession and deep learning matter more.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%可年化复利至 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户，压低广告利润；AI 成功不靠博士学位，痴迷与深度学习更重要。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize; coding has an infinite ceiling; benchmarks like LM Arena are hackable.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板；LM Arena 等基准可被操纵，不反映真实使用。

views.en: Frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; key metric is token value per user; power is the biggest bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates value; model is not the product.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你做事而非回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值；电力是最大瓶颈；跨模型、工具、设备的编排创造价值；模型不是产品。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions, not memorization.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义；教育应奖励好问题而非死记硬背。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the real challenge is designing human-agent collaboration interfaces.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: Software engineering demand will rise, not fall, via Jevons paradox; AI creates more programmers, and value accrues where the stack is differentiated.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 不会消灭软件工程师，反而会增加其数量并改变角色；价值积累在技术栈中有真正差异化的地方。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，而是渐进式改进；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年的产品进步。

views.en: Coding agent adoption grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and the token-max era ended in 2026.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体采用率六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，token 最大化时代在 2026 年 1 至 5 月间终结。

views.en: The abundance era is real and near; enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；企业更偏好第三方供应商而非实验室，真正的解锁是容量而非效率，同时坚持奇点并非迫在眉睫。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不真正好用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心；自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding, and frontier models struggle with bug finding due to missing training data and poor calibration.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他一贯认为基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型因缺乏训练数据、校准不佳而难以发现 bug。

views.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他进一步深化：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌握主导权；品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

views.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor; the AI shift will outlast the internet and take decades, and the IDE market is far bigger.
views.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：原本没料到要做自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型；AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年，IDE 市场也大得多。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view; play, short prompts, and fix-forward beat reverting code.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角：多玩多试、用短提示迭代，出问题让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

views.en: Security is the top concern for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox before exposing agents publicly.
views.zh: 同期他把安全列为智能体系统的头号问题：提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露智能体前必须先做沙箱隔离。

views.en: OpenClaw wins by being fun, weird, and humanlike, not corporate polish; open source agents democratize programming.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步认为 OpenClaw 的成功来自好玩、古怪、有人味，而非企业级打磨；开源智能体让非程序员也能参与编程。

views.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, so agents seem worse. Vibe coding is a slur for serious work.
views.zh: 他深化了此前的判断：模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差；严肃开发应叫智能体式工程，'氛围编程'是贬称。

views.en: Fun and gut-driven building lead to the next big thing; personal brand outlasts any product, and compute is the agent bottleneck.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把主线收束为：乐趣与直觉驱动创造，个人品牌比任何产品都持久，而智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力管理而非模型能力。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

episodes.tEn: The Architect Who Feared His Creation: Ilya Sutskever's AI Journey
From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if the base net is smart; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调只要基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者，而非全知全能的成品 AGI。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but opaque models raise safety concerns; AGI's core problem is power concentration, requiring a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但模型不透明加剧安全担忧；AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中，需要一家没有商业产品的公司来构建安全的超级智能。

views.en: A consistent thread: neural networks learn representations without explicit rules, and safety must keep pace with growing capability.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，而安全必须与不断增长的能力同步。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应建成通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力至关重要，安全研究必须现在就开始。

views.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws work but may hit limits, so planning/search and multimodal grounding plus algorithmic innovation are equally critical.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）可能十年内到来；缩放定律有效但可能触顶，因此结合规划与搜索、多模态数据接地，以及算法创新同样关键——Scaling（规模扩张）单独不够。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible, but video models show physics understanding without embodiment.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，2030 年实现 AGI（通用人工智能）可信；同时视频生成模型展现出无需具身的世界模型式物理直觉。

views.en: Shift to balance: 50% scaling, 50% innovation; world models and spatial intelligence are crucial, and current systems lack consistency and true creativity.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向平衡：一半靠 Scaling（规模扩张）、一半靠创新；世界模型与空间智能至关重要，而当前系统缺乏一致性、持续学习与真正的创造力。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and agents; safety becomes a collective-action problem requiring government regulation, not lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）仍需持续学习、记忆与智能体，安全已从实验室自律转向需要政府监管的集体行动问题，并强调 AI 应优先加速科学与健康。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。
