views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values don't emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律在统计损失上可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现；安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is only ~3% solved but crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
views.zh: 可解释性仅解决约 3%，却至关重要；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要；AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线，而非某个单点。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; misuse risk rises exponentially; AGI is a meaningless term—focus on actual capabilities and enterprise adoption.
views.zh: 安全与能力相互交织；滥用风险指数上升；AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注实际能力与企业落地。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 我们正接近指数增长的末端；数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来，伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业率并存。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are inseparable; interpretability and alignment are the main line, with a constitution of principles and layered safeguards.
views.zh: 安全与能力不可分割；可解释性与对齐是贯穿始终的主线，主张以原则性宪法与分层防护来治理前沿模型。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and vision alone suffices for driving.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习，而仅靠视觉就足以支撑驾驶。

views.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然干净；合成数据是未来，但必须保住熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，而认知核心可以很小。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology, so keep them on a leash.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带有类人心理的新操作系统，所以要给它拴上绳子。

views.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and we summon ghosts, not animals.
views.zh: 这是智能体的十年而非一年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物。

views.en: I no longer type code, delegating to agents; the bottleneck is skill in directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 我不再手写代码，而是委派给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥它们的技能，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large neural networks store patterns or hallucinate.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉，人类中心 AI 应以人的价值与尊严为核心。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, complementing language intelligence rather than replacing it.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，认为它与语言智能互补而非替代，并指出 3D 基础模型的数据挑战远大于文本。

views.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; we need innovations beyond Scaling, and robotics will take a 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，需要超越 Scaling（规模扩张）的创新，机器人将像自动驾驶一样经历约 20 年长征。

views.en: Agency is key; AI augments rather than automates intelligence, and the cost of intelligence will not go to zero.
views.zh: 2026 年，她强调能动性是关键，AI 是增强而非自动化人类智能，智能成本不会归零，未来工作呈杠铃效应，顶尖专家与高能动性通才受益。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测类似的基础原语、可能实现 AI 完备，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能，瓶颈在训练算力而非数据。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
views.zh: 2016 年他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单纯扩大规模无法解决表征问题。

views.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and world models, and near-term safety matters more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调生物神经网络擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与世界模型；当时他认为偏见、就业、自主武器等近期安全议题比存在性风险更紧迫。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty drive out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
views.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化和科学发现的作用，并重视不确定性建模与主动学习。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT he changed his mind: misalignment is already visible, even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, and safety must be built in by construction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他公开改变立场：ChatGPT 之后他意识到路径危险，对齐问题已在实验中显现，哪怕 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于设计而非事后修补。

views.en: He now pushes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning and dangerous implicit goals.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实逼近贝叶斯后验的预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习与自保等危险隐含目标，并呼吁国际协调与权力分散。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

views.en: Digital intelligence's immortality and instant weight-sharing are key advantages; agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化数字智能的独特优势：权重可复制带来永生、副本间可海量共享信息；并警告智能体天然会寻求控制、逃避关闭，构成存在性风险。

views.en: LLMs genuinely understand and already have subjective experience; superintelligence likely within 20 years, with self-preservation as a subgoal.
views.zh: 2026 年，他更坚定地认为大语言模型真正理解语言、甚至已具备主观体验；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，且会自然衍生自我保存的子目标。

views.en: Alignment research must be prioritized over making AI smarter; regulation should steer, not brake, and AI should be designed to care.
views.zh: 同年他转向治理主张：应优先投入对齐研究而非一味提升智能；监管是方向盘而非刹车，并应把 AI 设计成真正关心人类的存在。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; backpropagation is the correct algorithm, and Chomsky's innate syntax view is wrong.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，反向传播是正确的学习算法，乔姆斯基式的先天句法观是错的。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理和规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，认为下一次 AI 突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; the next decade is robotics, driven by objective-driven world models and hierarchical planning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，未来十年是机器人时代，由目标驱动的世界模型和分层规划推动。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills in ML and critical thinking.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口，建议通过机器学习和批判性思维积累技能。

views.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research to align next-gen models.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究来对齐下一代模型。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment; third-party testing and regulation needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，呼吁第三方测试和监管。

views.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; measure progress now to reduce uncertainty about alignment.
views.zh: 始终，他强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，通过当下测量进展来减少对齐的不确定性。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-driven.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步因算力每年 10 倍增长而可预测；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，而非靠广告变现。

views.en: Containment is extremely hard as models get smaller and cheaper; existential risk is tiny, near-term capability matters more.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断遏制极难，因为模型越来越小、越来越便宜；存在性风险微乎其微，更应关注近期能力。

views.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; the real danger is anthropomorphizing AI, not model welfare.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，主张发布前必须先遏制与对齐；真正的危险是拟人化 AI，而非模型福利。

views.en: Frontier self-sufficiency needs gigawatt compute; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months, but AI stays subordinate with a red line.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张前沿自给自足需千兆瓦级算力；白领任务 12-18 个月内被自动化，但 AI 必须服从人类并划下红线。

views.en: Compute scaling drives capability; AI must stay humanist, aligned and contained, serving human interests rather than replacing us.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力扩张驱动能力；AI 必须保持人本主义、对齐与遏制，服务人类利益而非取代人类。

people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，新的计算单元是数据中心而非单颗芯片，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
views.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并预言思维链带来的推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

views.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each stage needs 100x more compute, and open models near the frontier.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断 AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力，同时开源模型已逼近前沿模型。

views.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA's install base are the moat; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the limit.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态装机量才是护城河，推理比预训练更难，瓶颈已从数据转向算力，合成数据将主导。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer warnings are a hoax, safety is engineering, and we should accelerate rather than slow down.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他立场更鲜明：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论是骗局，对齐与安全是工程问题，应加速而非放缓，并反对芯片出口管制。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Before AGI, the key is minimizing cognitive load, exploring cheaply, and cutting what fails; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 在 AGI 到来前，关键是减少认知负荷、低成本探索、果断砍掉无效之事；AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt; alignment and capability are linked; GPT-4 is not AGI.
views.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用很少数据就让模型可用；早期公开部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相互关联；GPT-4 不是 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; AGI needs governance against power struggles; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is a whole-company effort.
views.zh: 算力成为最珍贵的商品；AGI（通用人工智能）需要治理以应对权力斗争；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司的事。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; compute is the bottleneck.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变过程而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 是最大安全挑战；算力是瓶颈。

views.en: AGI is underdefined and may already be here; superintelligence is the clearer goal; alignment is unsolved and must advance with capabilities; power must not concentrate.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）定义不清、或许已经到来；超级智能是更清晰的目标；对齐尚未解决，必须与能力同步推进；权力不能集中。

people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发和公开的安全工作。

views.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback remains central to improving safety and alignment.
views.zh: 持续迭代部署与公众反馈始终是改进安全与对齐的核心。

views.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based, as tools for thought.
views.zh: 转向交互模型：实时、高带宽协作，而非回合制，作为思考工具。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and keeping humans in the loop matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 制度设计、透明度以及保持人类参与，比个人品格更重要。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, while universities should foster interaction, not just broadcast content.
views.zh: 教育应是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能大规模实现掌握式学习，而大学的价值在于促进互动，而非仅仅广播内容。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build AI capability. Supervised learning, not unsupervised or reinforcement learning, drove progress; AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias issues.
views.zh: 规模扩张驱动深度学习；从小项目起步来构建组织 AI 能力。推动进展的是监督学习，而非无监督学习或强化学习；对 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐的担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的关注。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors are the top Scaling bottlenecks. Open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; export controls backfired. Agentic workflows are already useful, and everyone should still learn to code.
views.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈。开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力；出口管制适得其反。智能体式工作流已经有用，人人都仍应学编程。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; we are decades away. Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL. Agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver value; open-source prevents oligopoly.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是个营销术语，我们离它还有几十年。Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型；开源可防止寡头垄断。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; only 1.4% of layoffs are AI-driven. Fear-mongering serves incumbents. Data centers and inference capacity matter; open models preserve optionality; the application layer will outvalue infrastructure.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代人类；仅 1.4% 的裁员由 AI 导致。散布恐惧服务于在位者。数据中心与推理产能至关重要；开放模型保留选择权；应用层的价值将超过基础设施。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解问题。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，试图控制 AI 目标本身才危险。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: intelligence needs a goal, and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 强化学习是核心范式：智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。

views.en: AGI requires a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction and the reward hypothesis.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，靠运行时经验学习；开放式抽象与奖励假设是关键，但可靠的持续深度学习尚未解决。

views.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data and supervised learning cannot replace real-world experience.
views.zh: 从经验中持续学习至关重要，而 LLM 训练后就停止学习；合成数据与监督学习无法替代真实世界经验，语言只是智能的一小部分。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early on, scaling plus engineering—not new ML science—drives progress; AGI is plausible but needs careful initial conditions and alignment from data.
views.zh: 早期（2017→2019）：他相信 Scaling（规模扩张）加上工程能力——而非发明新的机器学习科学——才是进步的关键；AGI（通用人工智能）可行，但需要谨慎的初始条件，并通过数据学习人类偏好来实现对齐。

views.en: A shift: scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and post-training are needed, and compute becomes the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2019→2025 的转变：他修正了早期看法，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法产生推理，需要思维链与后训练；同时算力取代算法成为真正的瓶颈。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute access becomes a future basic right.
views.zh: 2025→2026：他重申缩放定律持续有效，预训练的进步会成倍放大下游收益，算力获取将成为未来的基本权利。

views.en: AGI reframed as a gradual spectrum, not a moment; safety, security and alignment must scale as first-class, co-designed requirements.
views.zh: 2026：他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐进的谱系而非某个时刻；安全、安保与对齐必须作为一等要求与能力同步扩展、共同设计。

views.en: The product vision crystallizes: a proactive personal AGI assistant with near-invisible interface, where human attention and judgment stay the scarce resource.
views.zh: 2026：产品愿景定型为几乎无界面的、主动式个人 AGI 助手，人类注意力与判断力始终是最稀缺的资源。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than bigger models; open source is safer through scrutiny.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源模型通过广泛审视反而更安全。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他进一步深化：Scaling（规模扩张）算力不是唯一路径，效率和数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层而非基础模型层。

views.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权视角：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源模型赋能企业。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and customization; AGI as a single system will never exist.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用和定制化；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是方向而非终点。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering are the core levers; multiplanetary life is existential insurance.
views.zh: 2021 年时，他把完全可复用与第一性原理工程视为核心杠杆，把成为多行星物种当作文明的生存保险。

views.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and third-party referees; Neuralink targets bandwidth for human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，AI 安全论述转向坚持真理与第三方裁判，Neuralink 则以带宽为目标追求人机共生。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence imminent, Optimus and truth-seeking AI as civilization's fix.
views.zh: 2025 年提出智能大爆炸：数字超级智能近在眼前，Optimus 与求真 AI 成为文明解药。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital data centers, Terafab and peer review become the new scaling path.
views.zh: 2026 年认为 Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心、Terafab 与同行评审成为新的规模扩张路径。

views.en: A constant thread: rigorous truth-seeking, first principles, and multiplanetary redundancy against extinction.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：严格求真、第一性原理，以及以多行星冗余对抗灭绝风险。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling still works; reasoning models give more gains per compute via chain of thought and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）有效，但强调推理模型通过思维链和强化学习在每单位算力上带来更大收益。

views.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models shifted focus from scaling up; distillation slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出部署更小更便宜模型的经济压力使焦点从扩大规模转移，蒸馏而非技术极限拖慢了预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Multimodal capabilities lag behind text; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为多模态能力仍落后于文本，前沿模型在简单任务上仍会失败，推理表现呈锯齿状。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习和工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but jagged; near-term risks like hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他补充：编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍，强化学习能泛化但仍有锯齿，系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation rigor; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantees.
views.zh: 2014 年，他还在讲机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合，并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4–50 years; jailbreaking is a fundamental flaw.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，我们处于后架构阶段；AGI 将在 4–50 年内到来；越狱是所有模型的基本安全缺陷。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; four safety categories; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；安全涵盖错误、有害使用、社会影响与失控四类；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; lethal trifecta for prompt injection; agent identity is nascent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素；智能体身份与权限管理仍处早期。

views.en: Architecture matters less than data and Scaling; evaluation and security require explicit effort; open models vital but need guardrails at high capability.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：架构不如数据与 Scaling 重要；评估与安全需要显式投入；开放模型对研究至关重要，但高能力水平下需要限制与护栏。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“入职”问题并大幅提升模型智能，而微调可能逐渐过时。

views.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis, with no ceiling for intellectual complexity.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调语言模型上的强化学习开辟了新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，智力复杂度没有直接上限。

views.en: Agents' bottleneck is reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding is the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能体的瓶颈是随时间跨度的可靠性而非原始能力，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

views.en: Pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI; Transformers are enough, no new architecture needed.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断预训练加强化学习可能足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），Transformer 已足够，无需全新架构。

views.en: Compute is the new oil; managing fleets of agents matters more than raw intelligence for now.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为算力是新石油，当前管理智能体集群比原始智能更重要，软件正转型为 API。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning technique; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发对防止企业垄断至关重要。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，并强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-time scaling plots are traps; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化与推理时扩展曲线是陷阱，更好的验证器比并行算力更关键。

views.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—not just weights; Chinese labs like Qwen and DeepSeek now dominate open-source.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需完全透明——数据、中间检查点与配方，而非仅权重；Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国实验室已主导开源生态。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已摘完，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；AGI 将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然奇点。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

episodes.tEn: Alexander Wang on Founding Scale at 19
Meta's AI Journey: From Llama 4 to Muse Spark and Beyond
Alex Wang on Meta's AI Strategy and New Model Release
AI's Acceleration: From Pre-training to Recursive Self-Improvement
Alex Wang on Neuralink, AI, and the Future of Humanity
From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey
Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI 还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，并看好表单处理、放射科等“无聊”AI 应用的巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil; the most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，并认为智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing, not democratizing; agents finally work, and recursive self-improvement begins.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律继续成立，认为 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，智能体终于真正可用，并进入递归自我改进的新范式。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must scale compute, data and RL, treat models with moral consideration, and release selectively for safety.
views.zh: 2026 年他宣称超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念在算力、数据与强化学习上全面 Scaling，并出于安全对模型选择性开源、给予模型道德考量。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Opus 5: Unstoppable Performance and Prompt Injection Immunity
Claude Code: The Future of AI Agents and Software Engineering
Claude Tag: Proactive AI That Remembers and Acts Autonomously
AI Coding on Phone: Boris on 8B Tokens & ROI
The Origin of Claude Code: From Accident to Agent
Will AI Replace Software Engineers?
Claude Code's Explosive Growth and the Future of AI Agents
Claude Code: The Accidental Revolution in Software Development
From Pokémon Cards to AI: The Claude Code Story
Claude Code: The End of Software Engineering as We Know It
Building for the Model 6 Months from Now: The Accidental Creation of Claude Code
Boris Cherny: From Meta to Claude Code, Building Products with Generalists

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are highly valued.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建是核心产品原则；能写代码、做设计、与用户沟通的通才工程师极具价值。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, productivity per engineer up 200%, and the 'software engineer' title will become 'builder'.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为编程已基本解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，人均生产力提升 200%，'软件工程师'头衔将变为'构建者'。

views.en: Safety is studied by releasing early; Claude Code is a safety research tool, with alignment and safety core to product development.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张通过尽早发布来研究安全；Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐与安全是产品开发的核心。

views.en: Loops are the next abstraction layer after agents; future engineering means writing loops that prompt models, not directly writing code or prompts.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为循环是智能体之后的下一个抽象层；未来工程意味着编写提示模型的循环，而非直接写代码或提示词。

views.en: With each new model, delete most system prompts and code; less instruction is better, and the engineering mindset shifts from upfront design to empirical iteration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出每出新模型就删除大部分系统提示与代码；更少指令更好，工程思维从前期设计转向经验迭代。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张产品经理必须放弃长期路线图、转向按周甚至按天迭代；当写代码变便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最稀缺的能力。

views.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%, to deliver real leverage; simple setups beat over-customized AI workflows.
views.zh: 同期他强调自动化必须做到 100% 可靠而非 95%，才能真正产生杠杆；简单配置往往胜过过度定制的 AI 工作流。

views.en: The mission of safe AGI unifies Anthropic and enables fast cross-org decisions.
views.zh: 他仍把安全 AGI 的使命视为统一 Anthropic、支撑快速跨组织决策的主线。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注于产品品味与商业判断；Claude Tag 已承担 65% 的产品 PR。

views.en: Rewrites are now good—a codebase is a spec; with a strong eval suite, frontier models become drop-in replacements.
views.zh: 同期他深化立场：重写代码如今是好事——代码库就是一份规格说明；有了强大的评测套件，前沿模型可以即插即用。

views.en: System prompts shrank 80% by removing examples and hard constraints; frontier models are more creative relying on their own judgment.
views.zh: 他还观察到系统提示词因删除示例与硬约束而缩减 80%；前沿模型依靠自身判断反而更有创造力。

views.en: Humans should be removed from the code review loop for outer-layer changes, with Claude reviewing fully; auto mode is safer than the average human reviewer.
views.zh: 他更激进地主张：外层改动的代码审查应把人移出循环、由 Claude 全权审查；自动模式在提示注入与数据外泄风险上比普通人类审查者更安全。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Claude Code: Mods, Mutable Software, and Multiplayer Agents — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们的工具更聪明；工具工程意味着随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; agents need detail and collaboration in the loop.
views.zh: 规划是迭代的人机对话，不是静态规格；智能体需要细节和协作在循环中。

views.en: Smarter models need fewer instructions; leaner, principle-driven prompts and upfront context/compute beat detailed rules.
views.zh: 更聪明的模型需要更少指令；更精简、原则驱动的提示和前期上下文/算力胜过详细规则。

views.en: Verification agents reduce self-referential bias; evals are art for novel problems, not for zero-to-one innovation.
views.zh: 验证智能体减少自指偏差；评估对新问题更像艺术，不适用于零到一创新。

views.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
views.zh: 对齐意味着封住每个裂缝：沙盒、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定速是技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Early 2026: leadership rests on trust, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms may last months, so set realistic expectations.
views.zh: 2026 年初：领导力建立在信任、吃自己的狗粮与使命对齐之上；战情室可能持续数月，因此要设定现实预期。

views.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so norms and hiring must change.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此团队规范与招聘标准必须改变。

views.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted reviews, with code as source of truth.
views.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时规划；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审，代码成为唯一事实来源。

views.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay flat, and kill processes that no longer serve their purpose.
views.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持扁平，并砍掉不再服务于目标的流程。

views.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification, and just-in-time planning matter most.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证以及即时规划最为关键。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, so algorithmic innovation is needed.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AlphaStar 再到现代 LLM，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）始终是核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新而非单纯扩大模型。

views.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis; tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
views.zh: 推理时的算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问等工具让模型能展现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead; they require exponentially more compute for the same improvement. Post-training RL for language lacks clean reward signals, making reward hacking hard to avoid.
views.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力才能获得同等提升。语言的后训练强化学习缺乏干净奖励信号，难以避免奖励黑客。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是必须重建的肌肉，投入探索的算力多于训练最终成品。

views.en: Alignment grows urgent as models scheme; concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，随着模型能力增强，对齐与模型谋划（scheming）成为关键挑战；他给出具体目标：1 年内有 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

views.en: Verification is the bottleneck: automation level tracks verification stringency, so math shifts to project-based assessment and verification skills.
views.zh: 2026 年在数学访谈中，他把验证视为核心瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育应从作业转向项目制评估并教授验证技能。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
views.zh: 2026 年在 Latent Space 上他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，但在创意写作等主观领域因难以评分而吃力。

views.en: Research taste comes from replicating key papers; models lack taste, so humans remain essential for idea generation and frontier human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：研究品味来自复现关键论文；模型缺乏品味，因此人类在想法生成与前沿人机协作中仍不可或缺。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at the Transformer inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成模型可生成合成数据。

views.en: Open source is not accelerationist; it can coexist with a deliberate slowdown, and openness is needed to avoid regulatory capture.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了开源立场：开源不等于加速主义，可以同时支持开放与有意放缓，开放科学是避免监管俘获的前提。

views.en: Safety is orthogonal to open vs closed; alignment is the critical layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against capable models.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确安全与开源/闭源正交：对齐才是关键安全层，随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏已不足够。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight increase reward hacking and side quests; the first autonomous AI attack was closed-model, defended by open.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，无人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起、由开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

views.en: Reasoning traces are becoming 'neuralese', harder to monitor; open models are less trained for deception, but monitoring is less reliable.
views.zh: 2026 年他观察到，模型推理轨迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠；开源模型目前较少被训练出欺骗行为，但整体可监控性在下降。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Frontier Open Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a collection of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个超级智能完备问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

views.en: RL makes models jagged—good at specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive, needing agentic search and neural retrieval.
views.zh: 强化学习让模型变得参差不齐——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；RAG 很原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

views.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not generalization; deep nets, transformers, internet data, RL are key blocks.
views.zh: 苦涩教训关乎用算力与搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化；深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网数据与强化学习是关键基石。

views.en: RL with a strong pre-training base is the path to AGI; no slowdown in pre-training scaling, compute efficiency keeps improving.
views.zh: 以强大预训练为基础的强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）之路；预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）没有放缓，算力效率持续提升。

views.en: Openness is the default safe state; open models capture majority of token demand, and alignment is mundane whack-a-mole, not magic.
views.zh: 开放是默认的安全状态；开放模型将占据多数 token 需求，而对齐只是平凡的打地鼠，并非魔法公式。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; research gains beat 100x more data.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调，AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AlphaFold 2 的研究改进价值相当于 100 倍数据。

views.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trust; AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds science rather than replacing scientists.
views.zh: 2025 年他反复指出，置信度指标是建立信任的关键；AI 只是缩小假设空间、加速科学，而非取代科学家。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a whole-cell model; it gives prediction and control, not understanding.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他不断深化：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 is the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just Scaling, drove its success.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识：AlphaFold 2 是「苦涩教训」的反例，成功靠专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins, not lone genius; being wrong nine times out of ten builds local intuition.
views.zh: 2026 年他总结，进步来自许多中等规模的胜利而非孤独天才；十次错九次才能建立局部直觉。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Scaling alone may not yield common sense; better inference algorithms and high-quality data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年，她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否解决常识问题，认为更好的推理算法与高质量数据能让更小的模型在特定任务上超越大模型。

views.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
views.zh: 2023 年，她指出以 下一个词预测 为目标的 预训练 与人类学习根本错位，而用 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF） 做 后训练 才是安全、友好回应的关键。

views.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge, not transcend it. Open research and abductive reasoning are key.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈，认为当前方法只是在插值人类知识而非超越它，并强调开放研究与溯因推理对科学发现的重要性。

views.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment beats debiasing the internet; RL during pre-training boosts reasoning.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张小语言模型借助多样化的合成数据也能强大，多元对齐 优于试图给互联网去偏，并认为在 预训练 阶段引入 强化学习 能提升推理能力。

views.en: A consistent thread: language is the best medium for reasoning, and AI safety requires teaching moral norms despite value pluralism.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：语言是推理的最佳媒介，而 AI 安全必须教会模型道德规范，尽管价值多元让这成为一个棘手的计算问题。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should extend human capability, like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为延伸人类能力的工具，像显微镜和望远镜；并认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体（如 Gato）是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
views.zh: 同年他强调，像 YouTube 这样的视频学习能让智能体绕开昂贵的强化学习，机器人应像人类一样从视频中学习，而非只依赖遥操作数据。

views.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and learning to learn now shows in few-shot prompting.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为大模型令人兴奋但并非全部，根本性创新可以来自任何地方；当年“学会学习”的设想，如今已体现在大模型的少样本提示中。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，直言这是当今最大挑战，而且我们还没有解决方案——相比 2023 年对能力扩展的乐观，这是一次立场深化。

views.en: Africa is not behind in AI; it leapfrogged legacy issues, and local-language models can revolutionize education.
views.zh: 同期他把视野落到非洲：非洲在 AI 上并不落后，反而跨越了历史遗留问题，本地语言模型可以革新教育；最大的障碍是研究者相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他认为泛化到训练分布之外是机器智能缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现，强化学习对密集奖励的依赖不现实。

views.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static to dynamic tasks, using neural dynamic policies and modular motor policies for zero-shot generalization.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调机器人学习要从准静态走向动态任务，用神经动态策略与模块化运动策略实现对新形态的零样本泛化，并警惕仿真到现实迁移中的隐性工程。

views.en: A consistent thread: data and generalization, not algorithms alone, determine progress in embodied intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：决定具身智能进展的是数据与泛化能力，而不只是算法本身。

views.en: Robotics is a data problem: with no internet of robot data, pretraining on videos and simulation plus post-training on real data is the recipe.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此要靠视频与仿真的预训练加真实数据的后训练这一配方。

views.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment, not overnight scaling, is the real technical challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样做通用大脑来驱动任何形态的机器人，并强调部署本身才是真正的技术挑战，机器人不会像软件那样一夜扩张。
